subject: general
question: The fractions (1)/(3), (4)/(7), (2)/(5) written in ascending order are:

options.text: All the fractions are equivalent fractions.

solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ 1/3 = 0.33

⇒ 4/7 = 0.57

⇒ 2/5 = 0.40

The ascending order are 1/3, 2/5, 4/7

**∴ The fractions (1)/(3), (4)/(7), (2)/(5) written in ascending order are (1)/(3), (2)/(5), (4)/(7) **
